default.question: What can I build with FrontLit?
default.answer: A marketing website, articles, documentation, product updates, customer support, and email — all from one connected dashboard.

default.question: Do I need to know how to code?
default.answer: No. Every page is assembled from ready-made blocks like this one, and you can customize copy, media and layout without touching code.

default.question: Can I use my own domain?
default.answer: Yes, every FrontLit site can be connected to a custom domain in a few clicks.

default.question: Is there a free plan?
default.answer: Yes, you can get started for free and upgrade as your audience grows.
